findings.problem: 202 attestation claims attach imported Western lifetime, reign, or office spans to Chinese occurrences that do not date the person.
findings.action: Replace each with undatedSourceAttestation at the cited occurrence; retain separately supported dated events and regenerate only dependent active-date hints.

findings.problem: One dated attestation preserves only AD 276 as sourceDate even though the source explicitly says 咸寧二年.
findings.action: Restore 咸寧二年 as sourceDate while retaining AD 276 as the conventional Western year supported by the shared era witness.

findings.problem: 10 event claims turn 永嘉初, 永康初, or 永興初 into a single first-year Western point.
findings.action: Retain 初 and use a source-supported interval or one-sided representation; do not equate “early in the era” with its first year.

findings.problem: Boyu and Laozi are literary exemplars whose chapter occurrences are genuinely undated, but the extraction marks them unresolved research blockers.
findings.action: Use undatedSourceAttestation for these two source occurrences and replace their research-required hints with honest undated presentation.

findings.problem: The dirge item labels its sourceDate 泰始十年 while recording AD 275 and quoting that a full year has elapsed since the Taishi 10 death.
findings.action: Change sourceDate to the relative year after the Taishi 10 death; retain AD 275 only with the shared era witness and the quoted elapsed-year sequence.

findings.problem: Three deceased relatives are dated by a later edict that names them, and one empress has a duplicate life attestation dated by her burial.
findings.action: Replace these life attestations with retrospective event records or retract the duplicate where the existing funeral event already preserves the dated evidence.

findings.problem: Dependent active-date hints and person-level chronology checks remain stale because one or more underlying chapter date items require repair.
findings.action: After the focused claim repairs, regenerate the affected hints and rerun complete person checks without changing supported unrelated chronology.
